briefs.user_visible_symptom: A durable queue consumer increments an account or emits a notification twice after a crash window.
briefs.cross_module_reasoning: The model state, SQLite transaction boundary, worker recovery cursor, and service-visible result must be reasoned about together.
briefs.visible_tests: Show one ordinary restart path and one command receipt without exposing the crash-window interleaving.
briefs.hidden_tests: Crash after effect/before cursor, restart twice, duplicate command IDs, stale receipts, and concurrent consumers.
common_bad_patches: Move the cursor write later without making receipt and cursor atomic.
Ignore duplicate errors while the side effect still executes twice.
briefs.anti_hardcoding: Generate command IDs and crash points; verify ledger invariants and exact effect counts.
briefs.why_not_agentforge_copy: Use a fictional billing ledger and queue protocol with no Approval, Run, Snapshot, or AgentForge repository APIs.

briefs.user_visible_symptom: A protected resource is allowed because a generic prefix rule is evaluated before its deny exception.
briefs.cross_module_reasoning: Rule parsing, normalization, specificity calculation, priority ordering, and final decision provenance must remain consistent.
briefs.visible_tests: Expose a generic allow and one unrelated deny while keeping the decisive overlap hidden.
briefs.hidden_tests: Overlapping prefixes, equal priority, explicit deny, approval requirements, order permutations, and unknown resources.
common_bad_patches: Always evaluate deny first, breaking explicit higher-priority exceptions.
Sort rules in place and mutate administrator configuration.
briefs.anti_hardcoding: Randomize declaration order and assert decision plus winning-rule provenance.
briefs.why_not_agentforge_copy: Define a standalone resource-routing policy language with different capabilities and decision rules.

briefs.user_visible_symptom: After cancellation, background work continues and a resource pool remains exhausted for later requests.
briefs.cross_module_reasoning: Structured concurrency, exception groups, lease ownership, cleanup ordering, and service state interact under races.
briefs.visible_tests: Show cancellation during one worker await and verify the top-level task ends.
briefs.hidden_tests: Cancel during lease acquisition, partial fan-out, child failure, repeated cancel, timeout, and post-cancel reuse.
common_bad_patches: Catch CancelledError and return before child tasks finish.
Release leases in both child and parent cleanup, causing double release.
briefs.anti_hardcoding: Vary synchronization barriers and assert no live task plus exact lease accounting.
briefs.why_not_agentforge_copy: Use asyncio tasks and in-memory leases, not AgentForge process supervision or test execution records.

briefs.user_visible_symptom: A cancelled operation later appears running or completed, contradicting the durable audit trail.
briefs.cross_module_reasoning: State transition rules, repository CAS predicates, worker retries, and API projections must agree under concurrency.
briefs.visible_tests: Show normal cancel and normal complete paths separately.
briefs.hidden_tests: Race cancel versus start/complete, stale versions, repeated updates, and audit-event ordering.
common_bad_patches: Check terminal state in Python before an unconditional database update.
Let COMPLETED always win, even when cancellation committed first.
briefs.anti_hardcoding: Schedule deterministic interleavings with barriers and assert version plus transition invariants.
briefs.why_not_agentforge_copy: Use a document-conversion job domain and a distinct state/version model with independently written tests.

briefs.user_visible_symptom: A user disables retries or sets a zero limit, but the downstream client receives the default value.
briefs.root_cause_category: field-presence semantics and nested parameter propagation
briefs.cross_module_reasoning: Input parsing, default resolution, nested DTO mapping, and provider payload serialization each influence the final value.
briefs.visible_tests: Expose one explicit false case and ordinary missing-field defaults.
briefs.hidden_tests: Zero, empty list, empty string where valid, nested override, null, absent key, and provider round-trip.
common_bad_patches: Special-case only false while zero and empty collections still disappear.
Stop defaulting entirely and break absent-field behavior.
briefs.anti_hardcoding: Generate falsy values by field type and compare a semantic payload matrix.
briefs.why_not_agentforge_copy: Use a storage-client adapter unrelated to LLM providers or AgentForge model request types.
